```{r}
read_if <- function(f) if (file.exists(f)) read_csv(f, show_col_types = FALSE) else NULL
not_computed <- function(f) cat(glue("*Not yet computed: `{basename(f)}` is missing. Set `run_analysis <- TRUE` and re-render.*\n\n"))

stat_rows  <- n_or_na(nrow(h_long))

stat_multi <- if (is.null(h_summ)) "—" else n_or_na(sum(h_summ$n_methods_sig >= 2))
```

## Overview

This notebook gathers the four primary single-nucleus WildR vs SPF analyses (MAST differential
expression, popAlign subpopulation modelling, D-SPIN regulatory-program responses and pySCENIC
regulon activity) in one place. For each method it states which run is current, the exact files
holding its results, and how its statistics were computed. It then stacks all four into one
harmonized long table keyed on **tissue × Allen level × cell type**. Every row is one tested
feature (gene, subpopulation, program or regulon), with a common effect, direction, p-value,
adjusted p-value and unit-of-inference column. Nothing upstream is recomputed. The harmonization
only reads saved outputs.

## Background

Each method was run in its own notebook with its own output layout, cell-type keys and
significance conventions. MAST keys units as `CS…_CLAS_01_AMY`, popAlign as
`class__AMY__CS…_CLAS_01`, D-SPIN as `AMY__CS…_SUPT_0001`, and pySCENIC as split stems. Asking
whether the same cell type responds to WildR on several readouts (expression, subpopulation
structure, program activity, regulon activity) meant joining four differently shaped tables by
hand. This notebook does that join once, reproducibly, and records the provenance of every input.
That gives later cross-method work (convergence ranking, gene-level overlap, figure panels) a
single object to load.

## Results

### Where each analysis lives

Each subsection gives the current run, the primary result file (the one the harmonization
reads), the supporting per-unit outputs, and the notebook that documents how it was produced.

::: {.callout-warning}
## Unit of inference differs between methods

**MAST** and **pySCENIC** test at the level of **nuclei** (no animal term). Their p-values
are anti-conservative for a WildR vs SPF claim, because the animal is the unit of replication.
**popAlign** and the **D-SPIN** test used here are **animal-level** (6 vs 6). A gap in
significance between these two groups is expected from this difference alone. The
`inference_unit` column records it on every row.
:::

#### MAST: per-cell-type differential expression

[DIFFERENTIAL EXPRESSION]{.eyebrow}

Hurdle model `zlm(~ microbiome + log_std_nFeature_RNA)` with an LRT on `microbiomeWildR`. It is
fit per **tissue × Allen class / subclass / supertype**, on cells with `keep_cell`, genes in ≥ 10 %
of cells, and ≤ 2,000 cells per group (subsampled). BH correction is within unit. The effect is
the `logFC` component coefficient (log2 CPM). Run date 2026-01-04 (batchtools registry
`.cluster_runs/2026-01-04_*_MAST_SingleNuclei`).

| What | Path |
|---|---|
| **Primary (hits, BH p_adjust < 0.1, all levels)** | [data/interim/mast/snRNASeq/mast_signif_hits_2026-08-17_p_adjust_0.1.csv]{.path} |
| Full per-unit results (all genes) | [data/interim/mast/snRNASeq/class_label/]{.path}, [subclass_label/]{.path}, [supertype_label/]{.path} (`<label>_<tissue>_2026-01-04.rds`) |
| Nominal-p hits per level | [data/interim/mast/snRNASeq/{class,subclass,supertype}_mast_signif_hits_2026-01-04.rds]{.path} |
| Model code / notebooks | [notebooks/R_scripts/mast_functions.R]{.path} · [notebooks/0X_MAST_SN.qmd]{.path} · [notebooks/0X_DEG_Analysis.qmd]{.path} |

```{r}
#| label: cell-tbl-src-mast
#| echo: false
#| results: asis
x <- read_if(src$mast_hits)
if (is.null(x)) not_computed(src$mast_hits) else {
  cat(glue("{format(nrow(x), big.mark=',')} gene × unit hits across {n_distinct(x$celltype_tissue)} units ",
           "({paste(names(table(x$cell_type_level)), table(x$cell_type_level), sep = ': ', collapse = ', ')})."), "\n\n")
  x %>% arrange(p_adjust) %>% head(5) %>%
    transmute(tissue, level = cell_type_level, cell_type_name, gene = str_remove(primerid, "-GRCm39$"),
              coef = signif(coef, 3), p_adjust = signif(p_adjust, 3)) %>%
    kable(caption = "MAST: five strongest hits (preview).") %>% print()
}
```

#### popAlign: subpopulation abundance and state shifts

[SUBPOPULATIONS]{.eyebrow}

Gaussian-mixture population models fit per **tissue × Allen class / subclass / supertype**.
Each component (subpopulation) is tested for an **abundance** change (WildR/SPF fraction,
permutation over animals) and a **state shift** (permutation). BH is applied across components.
Run `2026-10-04`, synthesis `2026-10-05` (Ensembl-keyed GO and contamination flag). The
2026-10-02 run and the un-suffixed `run_2026-10-04/` synthesis are superseded.

| What | Path |
|---|---|
| **Primary (one row per component, all tests)** | [tables/popAlign/snRNASeq/run_2026-10-04_synth-2026-10-05/popAlign_subpopulation_catalog.csv]{.path} |
| Separate test tables | `popAlign_abundance_tests.csv`, `popAlign_abundance_omnibus.csv`, `popAlign_state_shift_tests.csv` (same folder) |
| Curated leads | [tables/popAlign/snRNASeq/run_2026-10-04_synth-2026-10-05/popAlign_followup_leads.csv]{.path} |
| Per-unit model outputs / manifest | [data/interim/popalign/snRNASeq/]{.path} (`manifest_2026-10-04.csv`) |
| Figures | [figures/popAlign/snRNASeq/run_2026-10-04_synth-2026-10-05/]{.path} |
| Code / notebook | [notebooks/R_scripts/run_popalign_synthesis_sn.R]{.path} · [notebooks/0X_popAlign_SN.qmd]{.path} |

```{r}
#| label: cell-tbl-src-popalign
#| echo: false
#| results: asis
x <- read_if(src$popalign_cat)
if (is.null(x)) not_computed(src$popalign_cat) else {
  cat(glue("{nrow(x)} components across {n_distinct(x$unit_id)} units. ",
           "Smallest q (abundance) = {signif(min(x$q_abund, na.rm=TRUE), 2)}; ",
           "smallest q (state) = {signif(min(x$q_state, na.rm=TRUE), 2)}."), "\n\n")
  x %>% arrange(pmin(p_abund, p_state)) %>% head(5) %>%
    transmute(tissue, level, name, comp, log2fc_frac = signif(log2fc_frac, 2),
              p_abund = signif(p_abund, 2), q_abund = signif(q_abund, 2),
              p_state = signif(p_state, 2), q_state = signif(q_state, 2)) %>%
    kable(caption = "popAlign: five components with the smallest nominal p (preview).") %>% print()
}
```

#### D-SPIN: regulatory-program responses

[NETWORK PROGRAMS]{.eyebrow}

Program-level D-SPIN models fit per **tissue × Allen supertype** for the 140 hard-pass units.
Each animal is one condition (SPF = control). `relative_h` is each animal's program response
centred on SPF. D-SPIN does not emit p-values. The source notebook's own call is a **star
program**: same sign in every WildR animal. Fit 2026-08-09, DAVID annotation 2026-08-10.

| What | Path |
|---|---|
| **Primary (per unit)** | [data/interim/dspin/\<tissue\>__\<supertype_label\>/relative_responses.csv]{.path} + `sample_meta.csv`, `programs_genes.csv`, `network.csv` |
| Unit index / fit status | [data/interim/dspin/fit_summary.csv]{.path} · [data/interim/dspin/ranked_all.csv]{.path} |
| Summary tables | [tables/DSPIN/star_programs_david.csv]{.path} · [tables/DSPIN/unit_response_strength.csv]{.path} · [tables/DSPIN/program_annotations_david_all.csv]{.path} |
| Figures | [figures/DSPIN/snRNASeq/]{.path} |
| Notebook | [notebooks/0X_DSPIN_Analysis.qmd]{.path} |

```{r}
#| label: cell-tbl-src-dspin
#| echo: false
#| results: asis
x <- read_if(src$dspin_stars); fit <- read_if(src$dspin_fit)
if (is.null(x) || is.null(fit)) not_computed(src$dspin_stars) else {
  cat(glue("{sum(fit$status == 'ok')} units fit; {nrow(x)} star programs."), "\n\n")
  x %>% arrange(desc(abs(mean_h))) %>% head(5) %>%
    transmute(tissue, supertype_name, program_id, mean_h = signif(mean_h, 2), sd_h = signif(sd_h, 2), top_term) %>%
    kable(caption = "D-SPIN: five star programs with the largest mean WildR relative h (preview).") %>% print()
}
```

#### pySCENIC: regulon activity

[GENE REGULATORY NETWORKS]{.eyebrow}

The production run fits one GRN per **tissue × Allen class** (36 splits, raw UMIs, both
microbiome groups per loom). WildR vs SPF is tested with a Wilcoxon test on AUCell within each
split, with BH within split. Regulons are split-specific, so cross-class comparisons use TF
identity, not AUC values. Aggregated 2026-10-04. The 2026-08-08 subclass pilot (5k-cell
subsample, [data/processed/scenic/]{.path}) is **not** used here.

| What | Path |
|---|---|
| **Primary (all regulon tests, all splits)** | [data/processed/scenic_by_class/diff_regulons_all_splits.csv]{.path} |
| Significant hits / TF recurrence | [data/processed/scenic_by_class/diff_regulons_padj05_2026-10-04.csv]{.path} · [tf_hit_recurrence.csv]{.path} · [hit_counts_by_split.csv]{.path} |
| Per-split GRNs, AUCell, logs | [data/interim/scenic/by_class/snRNASeq_\<tissue\>_\<class_label\>/]{.path} |
| Run status | [data/processed/scenic_by_class/run_status.csv]{.path} |
| Figures | [figures/SCENIC/snRNASeq_by_class/]{.path} |
| Notebook | [notebooks/0X_SCENIC_pySCENIC.qmd]{.path} |

```{r}
#| label: cell-tbl-src-scenic
#| echo: false
#| results: asis
x <- read_if(src$scenic_splits)
if (is.null(x)) not_computed(src$scenic_splits) else {
  cat(glue("{format(nrow(x), big.mark=',')} regulon tests across {n_distinct(paste(x$tissue, x$class_label))} splits; ",
           "{sum(x$padj < 0.05, na.rm=TRUE)} at padj < 0.05."), "\n\n")
  x %>% arrange(padj) %>% head(5) %>%
    transmute(tissue, class_name, regulon, delta = signif(delta, 3), n_SPF, n_WildR, padj = signif(padj, 3)) %>%
    kable(caption = "pySCENIC: five strongest regulon tests (preview).") %>% print()
}
```

::::

### The harmonized table

All four sources are stacked into one long table with a fixed schema. popAlign contributes two
rows per component, one per test. A row's `significant` flag uses a single harmonized threshold
(**adjusted p < `r sig_q`**). `native_hit` keeps each method's own call, so neither convention
is lost. Every unit is mapped to its parent Allen subclass and class through a hierarchy lookup
built from the cell metadata, which allows class-only (pySCENIC) and supertype-only (D-SPIN)
results to be compared.

| Column | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `method` | MAST · popAlign · DSPIN · pySCENIC |
| `unit_key` | `<level>__<tissue>__<celltype_label>`: the join key across methods |
| `tissue`, `level`, `celltype_label`, `celltype_name` | Allen unit tested (`level` ∈ class / subclass / supertype) |
| `class_label/name`, `subclass_label/name` | parent Allen labels (from the hierarchy lookup) |
| `feature_type`, `feature_id` | gene · subpopulation (`compN`) · program (`PN`) · regulon (`Tf.pos`) |
| `genes` | gene symbol(s) for the feature: the gene, top component markers, first 10 program genes, or the TF |
| `test`, `effect`, `effect_metric`, `direction` | test name; WildR − SPF effect on the method's own scale; `WildR_up` / `SPF_up` |
| `p_value`, `p_adj`, `padj_scope` | nominal p; adjusted p; the family it was adjusted over |
| `significant` | `p_adj < 0.1` (harmonized) |
| `native_hit`, `native_rule` | the method's own significance call and its rule |
| `inference_unit` | nuclei vs animals (see callout above) |
| `n_SPF`, `n_WildR`, `source_file` | group sizes where reported; exact input file |

: Schema of the harmonized long table. {#tbl-schema}

Outputs: [tables/SN_Integration/SN_Integration_harmonized_long_2026-10-06_r2.csv]{.path} (also as
RDS: [data/interim/sn_integration/sn_harmonized_results_2026-10-06_r2.rds]{.path}), the per-unit
wide summary [tables/SN_Integration/SN_Integration_celltype_summary_2026-10-06_r2.csv]{.path}, the
class rollup [tables/SN_Integration/SN_Integration_class_rollup_2026-10-06_r2.csv]{.path}, and the
input registry [tables/SN_Integration/SN_Integration_source_registry_2026-10-06_r2.csv]{.path}.

```{r}

#| echo: false

  h_reg %>% mutate(source_file = str_remove(source_file, fixed(paste0(wkdir, "/")))) %>%
    kable(caption = "Inputs read by the harmonization, with row counts and file modification times.") %>% print()
}
```

[**Figure 1.**]{.fig-num} Cross-method view of the harmonized table. (A) For every tissue ×
cell-type unit, the smallest adjusted p across that method's features. Dashed line: the
harmonized threshold (0.1). (B) Number of significant features (adjusted p < 0.1) per tissue ×

::: {.takeaways}
**Key takeaways**

- At a common threshold, only the two **nuclei-level** methods (MAST, pySCENIC) give
  significant WildR vs SPF features. Neither **animal-level** method (popAlign, D-SPIN Welch)
  reaches adjusted p < 0.1 in any unit.
- MAST and pySCENIC agree on *where* the signal is. 22 tissue × class units carry both DE genes
  and differential regulons, led by glia (Astro-Epen, OPC-Oligo) in both tissues and HY / CNU
  neurons in HYP.
- Because of the inference-unit gap, a "convergent" call should rest on animal-consistent
  evidence (D-SPIN star programs, popAlign nominal effects, pseudobulk), not on MAST/SCENIC
  p-values alone.
:::

#### Per-unit summary (all methods side by side)

One row per tissue × level × cell type, with the number of features tested, significant and
natively called, plus the smallest adjusted p for each method. `n_methods_sig` counts methods
with at least one significant feature in that exact unit. `MAST_n_tested` is blank because only
MAST hits were saved.

```{r}
#| label: tbl-summary-display
#| echo: false
if (is.null(h_summ)) not_computed(h_summ_f) else {
  h_summ %>%
    select(tissue, level, celltype_name, n_methods_sig, ends_with("_n_sig"), ends_with("_n_native"), ends_with("_min_padj")) %>%
    mutate(across(ends_with("_min_padj"), ~ signif(.x, 2))) %>%
    datatable(rownames = FALSE, filter = "top", extensions = "Buttons",
              options = list(pageLength = 15, scrollX = TRUE, dom = "Bfrtip", buttons = c("csv")))
}
```

#### Feature-level hits (browsable)

All significant or natively called features from popAlign, D-SPIN and pySCENIC, plus the top 5
MAST genes per unit. The full long table, including every non-significant popAlign, D-SPIN and
pySCENIC test, is in the CSV.

```{r}
#| label: tbl-long-display
#| echo: false
if (is.null(h_long)) not_computed(h_long_f) else {
  bind_rows(
    h_long %>% filter(method != "MAST", significant | native_hit),
    h_long %>% filter(method == "MAST") %>% group_by(unit_key) %>% slice_min(p_adj, n = 5, with_ties = FALSE) %>% ungroup()
  ) %>%
    transmute(method, tissue, level, celltype_name, feature_id, genes = str_trunc(genes, 60), test,
              effect = signif(effect, 3), direction, p_adj = signif(p_adj, 3), significant, native_hit,
              inference_unit) %>%
    arrange(p_adj) %>%
    datatable(rownames = FALSE, filter = "top", extensions = "Buttons",
              options = list(pageLength = 15, scrollX = TRUE, dom = "Bfrtip", buttons = c("csv")))
}
```

[Source: cell `cell-harmonize`](#cell-harmonize){.provenance} · Full CSV:
[tables/SN_Integration/SN_Integration_harmonized_long_2026-10-06_r2.csv]{.path}

#### Using the harmonized table downstream

```{r}
#| label: example-usage
#| eval: false
#| code-fold: false
h <- readRDS(file.path(wkdir, "data/interim/sn_integration/sn_harmonized_results_2026-10-06_r2.rds"))

# Units where expression (MAST) and a D-SPIN star program both point the same way
mast_dir  <- h %>% filter(method == "MAST", significant) %>% count(unit_key, direction, name = "n_genes")
dspin_dir <- h %>% filter(method == "DSPIN", native_hit) %>% count(unit_key, direction, name = "n_star")
inner_join(mast_dir, dspin_dir, by = c("unit_key", "direction"))

# Gene-level: MAST DE genes that also sit in a D-SPIN program in the same unit
dspin_genes <- h %>% filter(method == "DSPIN") %>%
  separate_rows(genes, sep = ", ") %>% select(unit_key, gene = genes, program = feature_id, dspin_star = native_hit)
h %>% filter(method == "MAST", significant) %>% select(unit_key, gene = genes, coef = effect) %>%
  inner_join(dspin_genes, by = c("unit_key", "gene"))
```

## Next Steps

- **Done:** located and documented the current run of each primary SN analysis, and joined all
  four into one schema-fixed table (26,056 rows) with a cell-type summary, a class rollup and an
  input registry.
- Add an **animal-level sensitivity layer for MAST and pySCENIC**. Pseudobulk DE (DESeq2 /
  edgeR, already under [data/interim/DESeq2/]{.path}) and per-animal mean AUCell compared 6 vs 6
  would put all four methods on the same unit of replication before convergence is scored.
- Save full MAST results (all tested genes, not only hits) into one long file. This would give
  MAST real `n_tested` counts and let MAST join gene-level with D-SPIN program genes and
  popAlign markers without a selection bias.
- Build a **convergence score** per unit (and per gene) from the harmonized table, weighting
  animal-level evidence above nuclei-level evidence, and use it to choose follow-up cell types.

# Code & Provenance {.code-appendix}

Every chunk below is gated on `run_analysis` (set in `setup-display`), so rendering never
recomputes. All logic lives in two scripts:
[notebooks/R_scripts/harmonize_sn_results.R]{.path} (loaders for each method plus the
harmonization) and [notebooks/R_scripts/plot_sn_integration_figures.R]{.path} (Figure 1). Both
read only the saved outputs listed above. The scripts never overwrite outputs: a second run on
the same day writes with a `_r2`, `_r3`, … suffix.

| Run tag | Date | Status |
|---|---|---|
| `2026-10-06` | 2026-10-06 | Superseded. Five pilot D-SPIN units had a blank `supertype_label` in `fit_summary.csv`, which merged them into two unit keys. MAST `n_tested` counted hits only. |
| `2026-10-06_r2` | 2026-10-06 | **Current.** D-SPIN label parsed from `unit_id`; MAST `n_tested` set to NA. |

The only statistic computed here (not in the source notebooks) is the D-SPIN **Welch t-test** of
`relative_h`, WildR vs SPF across animals (6 vs 6) per program, with BH across all 2,800 programs.
The smallest nominal p is 2.9 × 10⁻⁴ and the smallest adjusted p is 0.80.

```{bash}
#| label: cell-commands
#| eval: false
```
